office_does: A Court of Appeals judge reviews appeals from superior-court cases; District 2 judges are elected for six-year terms by voters in Clallam, Grays Harbor, Jefferson, Kitsap, Mason and Thurston counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Erik D. Price, on the Court of Appeals since 2021 and now Division II's acting chief judge, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge since 2021 and Division II's acting chief judge; previously a Thurston County Superior Court judge (2012-2021) and a civil litigator for 19 years. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Court of Appeals judge since 2021; acting chief judge of Division II [S1]
Thurston County Superior Court judge 2012-2021, including presiding judge and drug court chief judge [S1]
Unopposed on the 2022 ballot, with 98.6% of the Clallam vote [S2]
